advisor.message: This Advisor is designed to assist you with tweaking some extra BoB settings. You'll notice many dialogs in the advisor. Just read the advisor, respond to any posed questions, then hit the "OK" button to continue. If you are uncertain of any settings, just hit the "skip" button. Don't forget to read the manual.pdf located in the "Docs" directory inside BoB for more information.

dialogue.text: Are you using Windows XP? Please select the correct response for your system, then hit the "OK" button.

If you experience a flickering screen in the main dialogues, you can set your desired refresh rate for Battle of Britain. Most modern multisync monitors can support refresh rates of 60, 75, 85 and sometimes several others. The BDG would strongly advise you to check your monitor specs before adjusting this. (Units are Hz)

choice.message: You might also want to disable all videos, if you experience problems starting BoB.

dialogue.text: Do you want to disble in-game videos? If you select yes, the next few dialog boxes will provide options to disable only the intro video, all in-game vidoes or only the videos for quickmissions.
Do you want play the intro video?
Do you want to skip ALL videos (except the intro video)?
Do you want to skip only the quickvideos? This makes browsing through all available quick missions much faster.
Do you want to configure the available Field of View variables? (Generally, there is a small amount of adjustment, most noticeable in the amount of cockpit and gauges seen while flying).
This variable will adjust the narrow (zoomed in) cockpit view when pressing the default keyboard command Shift-F9 in the game.
This variable will adjust the midsize cockpit view when pressing Shift-F10 in the game.
This variable will adjust the widest (zoomed out) cockpit view when pressing Shift-F11 in the game.
This value will adjust the narrow (zoomed in) cockpit view when pressing Shift-F12 in the game.
This value will adjust the large (zoomed out) cockpit field of view when pressing Shift-F12 in the game.
This value will adjust your initial cockpit view size (typically, your default view), or when pressing the F5 button in game.
This is the lower boundary of the narrow (zoomed in) cockpit view; Use "control +" to zoom in; it is not advisable to adjust this below the default setting of 18 or view anomalys may occur.
This is the upper boundary of the wide (zoomed out) cockpit field of view; Use "control -" to zoom out; it is not advisable to adjust this above the default setting of 80 or view anomalys may occur.

choice.message: This is the end of the Field of View changes. (There were alot of BDG options weren't there?)

dialogue.text: Do you want to customize the Padlock Center Enemy function? (This will allow you to customize padlocking enemy aircraft directly ahead of your aircraft; default keyboard command for padlock center enemy is "s").
This value will adjust half the width of the area in which you will be able to padlock aircraft. The units are angles, and smaller values will narrow the focus of your padlock.
This will adjust half the height of the area in which you will be able to padlock aircraft. The units are angles, and smaller values will again narrow the focus of your padlock.
Do you want to have your padlock view outlined by a red rectangle? NOTE: If you select yes, you may then use "Shift T" in game to show the target box.
Are you going to use the padlock view with the keyboard/joystick hat button? If so, press YES. If you want to use the mouse for padlock view press NO.
Do you want to enable the enemy position indicator (EPI=the small oval showing enemy and friendly aircraft in a 3d representation; located in the upper left screen while flying).
This value adjusts the width of the Enemy Position Indicator (50 is default; smaller values will decrease the width of the EPI, while larger values will increase the width size).
This value adjusts the height of the Enemy Position Indicator (10 is default; smaller values will decrease the height of the EPI, while larger values will increase the height size).
Are you interested in adjusting the aircraft labels? (colored labels identifying aircraft)
Do you want aircraft labels to appear gradually?
This value adjusts the range (in meters) at which aircraft labels will begin to appear. NOTE: Press the skip button if you are uncertain about changing these values.
This value adjusts the range (in meters) at which aircraft labels will appear with dim coloration. NOTE: Press the skip button if you are uncertain about changing these values.
This value adjusts the range at which aircraft labels will appear with full coloration. NOTE: Press the skip button if you are uncertain about changing these values.
This value adjusts the colour of the labels of allied planes. Use the sliders to adjust the color value.
This value adjusts the colour of the labels of enemy planes. Use the sliders to adjust the color value.
Do you want to display only aircraft type labels? Setting this to No/off will display full callsigns of allied planes outside your squadron.
Are you interested in adjusting the infoline? (This is the small bar at the bottom of the screen that displays various information, such as heading, altitude, etc.).
Do you want to disable the black background of the infoline, making it a bit less intrusive?
Do you want to see an ammo counter while flying RAF planes? Historically, they did not have an ammo counter in early aircraft, so you'll need to estimate your ammo.
Do you want to see your current throttle setting displayed in the info line? Selecting off/disable will require you to use cockpit gauges.
Do you want to display imperial units while flying RAF planes, and metric units while flying for the Luftwaffe?
Are you interested in changing the Artificial Intelligence of computer controlled aircraft?
Enabling this makes AI pilots bail out on engine damage. Select "yes/on" to enable this feature.
This feature enables stragglers, and more varied damage behaviour for bombers. Select "yes/on" to enable this feature.
Do you want to use TrackIR with BoB? (TrackIR is an alternative screen control/viewing technology requiring specific hardware; Do not adjust unless you have this hardware).
Do you want to the padlock to override TrackIR? (Allows padlocking by keypress or joystick to override TrackIR viewing)
